summary: The update channel picks a namespace-scoped (stable-2.x, tighter security, needed for several operator versions in one cluster) or cluster-scoped (one operator for all AAP CRs) operator; AAP can't go in the default namespace, and aap or a dedicated custom namespace is recommended.
questions: Should I use a namespace-scoped or cluster-scoped AAP Operator?
Can I install AAP in the default namespace?
How do I run several AAP Operator versions in one cluster?
Which namespace should AAP use on OpenShift?

answer_card.title: Namespace vs cluster-scoped operator
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Namespace-scoped** (`stable-2.x`): one namespace, tighter security, needed for several operator versions in one cluster, easier debugging.
- **Cluster-scoped** (`stable-2.x-cluster-scoped`): one operator manages AAP CRs in all namespaces; needs admin on all namespaces.

Never use the `default` namespace; use `aap` or a namespace that runs only AAP.
